secure.same_browser: Use this same browser on this device to open the login details. If you clear its data or change device, you can ask the seller to send them again once.
secure.key.title: Your key for the login details
secure.key.explain: The seller will lock the login details with a key that only this browser holds. TrustBazaar keeps the locked details but can never read them.
secure.key.create: Create the key in this browser
secure.key.created: Your key is created. You can go back to the order and pay.
secure.key.ready: Your key is in this browser.
secure.key.fingerprint_hint: The seller sees the same fingerprint before sending. For a valuable sale, compare it with the seller by phone.
secure.key.not_buyer: Only the buyer creates this key.
secure.key.after_payment: The key is fixed once the order is paid.
secure.key.acknowledge_first: First confirm the notice about the publisher's rules on the order page.
secure.key.other_browser: The key for this order was created in another browser. Open this page in that browser; only it can open the login details.
secure.deliver.title: Send the login details
secure.deliver.not_seller: Only the seller sends the login details.
secure.deliver.not_expected: The login details are not expected now.
secure.deliver.again: The buyer lost the key and asked for the login details again. Send them for the buyer's new key.
secure.deliver.fingerprint_hint: The buyer sees the same fingerprint on their key page. For a valuable sale, compare it with the buyer by phone before sending.
secure.deliver.explain: The details are locked in this browser with the buyer's key; only the locked form is sent. TrustBazaar cannot read them.
secure.deliver.recovery_hint: One code on each line, if the account has any.
secure.deliver.need: Enter the login and the password.
secure.deliver.too_long: The details are too long. Shorten the note or the codes.
secure.deliver.seal_failed: The details could not be locked in this browser. Please try an up-to-date Chrome, Firefox, Edge or Safari.
secure.deliver.done: The login details are sent. Nothing you typed is kept in this page.
secure.deliver.sent: The buyer has the login details.
secure.deliver.takeover_by: They take over the account by
secure.credentials.title: The login details
secure.credentials.not_buyer: Only the buyer opens the login details.
secure.credentials.not_yet: The seller has not sent the login details yet.
secure.credentials.rekey_waiting: You asked for the login details again. The seller must send them for your new key.
secure.credentials.rekey_due: The seller must send them by
secure.credentials.gone: The handover has ended and the login details have been deleted.
secure.credentials.no_key: This browser does not have the key for these login details.
secure.credentials.cannot_open: The login details could not be opened with the key in this browser.
secure.credentials.private: Only you can see these. Change them now, as the checklist says.
secure.credentials.disputed: You reported that the login details do not work. An operator will decide; see the order.
secure.checklist.title: Take over the account
secure.checklist.explain: Do each step in the game, then confirm it here. A confirmed step cannot be undone. If you do not finish in time, the takeover is treated as complete when the time ends.
secure.checklist.complete: The takeover is complete. The protection period is running.
secure.report.title: If the login details do not work
secure.report.start: The login details do not work
secure.report.consequence: This opens a dispute and the payment stays held until an operator decides. You can report this only until you confirm changing the recovery e-mail.
secure.report.hint: At least 20 characters, if you write something. Never write the password here.
secure.report.too_short: Write at least 20 characters, or leave it empty.
secure.rekey.title: Ask for the login details again
secure.rekey.explain: You can do this once. A new key is created in this browser, and the seller must send the login details again for it; your takeover time starts again when they arrive.
secure.rekey.ask: Create a new key and ask again
secure.rekey.done: The seller has been asked to send the login details again by
secure.error.feature-off: Game accounts are switched off for now.
secure.error.credentials-not-expected: The login details are not expected now.
secure.error.deadline-passed: The time to send the login details has ended.
secure.error.stale-key-version: The buyer's key has changed. Check the new fingerprint and send again.
secure.error.none: There are no login details to open.
secure.error.key-fixed: A key is already registered for this order.
secure.error.not-acknowledged: First confirm the notice about the publisher's rules on the order page.
secure.error.not-a-p256-point: This browser made a key the server could not use. Please try another browser.
secure.error.takeover-not-in-progress: The takeover is not in progress.
secure.error.recovery-email-confirmed: You confirmed changing the recovery e-mail, so this is no longer possible.
secure.error.rekey-used: The one request to send again has been used.
